A term that is an adjective is identified as such by placing a comma and adj. in italic type after the term. The definition is

A term that is a noun is stated in the singular form.
C2.4  Committee Decisions
The significant Definitions Subcommittee decisions are recorded here to inform the reader as to the logic applied in arriv-
ing at the definition format.
C2.4.1  Application Mode. Where the process term variation includes a reference to application mode, e.g., automatic
brazing, it has been decided to reduce redundancy in the definitions by making reference to a common application mode
definition. The definition in this case will have the format “See xxxx process,” where xxxx is one of the application
modes listed in Table A4.
